cards.example_en: We consult the coach before changing the match plan.
cards.example_zh: 更改比赛方案之前，我们会先和教练商量。

cards.example_en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
cards.example_zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。
cards.explain_zh: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

cards.example_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
cards.explain_zh: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。

cards.example_en: A narrow strip of grass separates the two roads.
cards.example_zh: 一条狭窄的草带将两条路分开。
cards.explain_zh: strip的过去式为stripped；剥夺用strip sb of sth。

cards.example_en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
cards.example_zh: 这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。
cards.explain_zh: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。

cards.example_en: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
cards.example_zh: 部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The teacher's intervention stopped the argument.
cards.example_zh: 老师的介入制止了争吵。

cards.example_en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
cards.example_zh: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。
cards.explain_zh: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

cards.example_en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。
cards.explain_zh: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

cards.example_en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
cards.example_zh: 学校在评估学生的整体进步时，应将实践技能与考试成绩一并考虑。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Eating too much chocolate is my only vice.
cards.example_zh: 吃太多巧克力是我唯一的坏习惯。
cards.explain_zh: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

cards.example_en: Turning our garage into a kitchen was a radical change.
cards.example_zh: 把车库改成厨房是一次彻底的改变。
cards.explain_zh: radical change指根本性改变，不一定涉及政治。

cards.example_en: Turning our garage into a kitchen was a radical change.
cards.example_zh: 把车库改成厨房是一次彻底的改变。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The twins dress similarly but have very different personalities.
cards.example_zh: 这对双胞胎穿着相似，性格却很不一样。
cards.explain_zh: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。

cards.example_en: Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.
cards.example_zh: 孩子往往通过观察身边的成年人，学习在社交场合如何举止得当。
cards.explain_zh: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

cards.example_en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
cards.example_zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。
cards.explain_zh: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

cards.example_en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
cards.example_zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Cooking together added a new dimension to our friendship.
cards.example_zh: 一起做饭让我们的友谊有了新的层面。
cards.explain_zh: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。

cards.example_en: Urban planning has a social dimension, since the design of neighbourhoods can influence how frequently residents interact.
cards.example_zh: 城市规划具有社会层面，因为社区设计会影响居民互动的频率。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Subsequent lessons built on the grammar from Monday.
cards.example_zh: 随后的课都建立在星期一学的语法之上。

cards.example_en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
cards.example_zh: 医生检查了我疼痛的喉咙，看是否有感染迹象。
cards.explain_zh: infection既可指感染过程，也可指一次具体感染。

cards.example_en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
cards.example_zh: 改善卫生条件可以降低感染风险，尤其是在难以获得洁净水的社区。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
cards.example_zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。
cards.explain_zh: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。

cards.example_en: Organising my tools improved the efficiency of my work.
cards.example_zh: 把工具整理好提高了我的工作效率。
cards.explain_zh: efficiency强调少浪费；effectiveness强调达到效果。

cards.example_en: Improving energy efficiency in public buildings can reduce government spending and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
cards.example_zh: 提高公共建筑的能源利用效率，可以减少政府开支并降低温室气体排放。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
cards.example_zh: 请把你的脏靴子放在厨房门外。
cards.explain_zh: 比较级dirtier，最高级dirtiest。

cards.example_en: That surprising statistic made us check the survey again.
cards.example_zh: 那项令人惊讶的统计数据让我们再次核查了调查结果。
cards.explain_zh: statistics表数据用复数谓语，表统计学用单数谓语。

cards.example_en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。
cards.explain_zh: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。

cards.example_en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
cards.example_zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We stayed at a quiet resort beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们住在湖边一处安静的度假村。
cards.explain_zh: resort to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
cards.example_zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。
cards.explain_zh: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

cards.example_en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
cards.example_zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

cards.example_en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。
cards.explain_zh: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

cards.example_en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。
cards.explain_zh: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

cards.example_en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
cards.example_zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。
cards.explain_zh: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

cards.example_en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
cards.example_zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
cards.example_zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。
cards.explain_zh: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

cards.example_en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
cards.example_zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The nurse placed the bloody bandage in a sealed container.
cards.example_zh: 护士将带血的绷带放进密封容器。

cards.example_en: My neighbour became an ally in saving the park.
cards.example_zh: 在保护公园这件事上，我的邻居成了我的盟友。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。

cards.example_en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。
cards.explain_zh: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。

cards.example_en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
cards.example_zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。

cards.example_en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
cards.example_zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Leila gave a mature response when her plans changed.
cards.example_zh: 计划改变时，莱拉作出了成熟理智的回应。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指身体发育成熟，也可指处事明智。

cards.example_en: She briefly checked the map before we left the metro station.
cards.example_zh: 离开地铁站前，她简短地看了看地图。

cards.example_en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。
cards.explain_zh: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

cards.example_en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
cards.example_zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
cards.example_zh: 请轻轻关门，别打扰爸爸。
cards.explain_zh: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。

cards.example_en: Trees sustain many kinds of life.
cards.example_zh: 树木维持着多种生命。
